messages.subject: Use of Likert variables in SEM...
parts: Hello! I'm new to the group and I would like to ask some questions about SEM. Is it possible to use 4-category Likert variables, specifically for moderations and moderated mediations between latent variables?

messages.author: f6d12b388faad456
messages.subject: Re: Use of Likert variables in SEM...
parts:
If by likert variables you mean "ordinal" items, it's possible to do SEM. You can try to fit it in lavaan saying which variables are ordinal through the parameter "ordered" and lavaan will automatically change the estimator to WLSMV.
Doing moderations (interactions) is not so easy. From what I know, you have to estimate the interaction effect and include it in your database as a new variable. This means that you can only include moderations between manifest variables, but not latent variables.

Best,
Yago
